plan.name: Check if there is already a hot mug available
plan.strategy: Assume there may be a hot mug already in the room, and locate and use it directly.
steps: Survey the room to see if a hot mug is already on the countertop, shelf, or in a cabinet.
If a hot mug is found, take it directly to the coffeemachine.
If no hot mug is found, proceed to search for a mug and heat it using either the microwave or stove.
